headline: Margins rebound sharply while revenue stays about flat
summary_short: Nike reported diluted EPS of $0.72, up from $0.14 a year earlier and $0.35 in the prior quarter. Revenue of $10.97B was down 1.1% y/y and 2.7% q/q; gross margin expanded to 49.2% from 40.3% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $10.97B was down 1.1% y/y and 2.7% q/q. Gross margin rose to 49.2% from 40.3% y/y (40.2% q/q), roughly an 890bp y/y expansion. Operating margin (EBIT/revenue) climbed to 11.9% from 2.9% y/y (4.9% q/q). Net margin rose to 9.7% from 1.9% y/y (4.6% q/q). EBITDA of $1.51B was up 192.3% y/y and 96.9% q/q. Net income of $1.07B rose 406.6% y/y and 105.6% q/q. Diluted EPS of $0.72 was up 414.3% y/y and 105.7% q/q.
